mapper.select: select channel_id,target_process_definition_key,correlation_type,correlation_value, outbound_sequence,inbound_sequence,revision_no from wf_collaboration_channel where channel_id=#{channelId} for update
mapper.update: update wf_collaboration_channel set outbound_sequence=#{sequenceNo},revision_no=revision_no+1,update_time=current_timestamp(3) where channel_id=#{channelId} and revision_no=#{expectedRevision} and outbound_sequence=#{sequenceNo}-1

update wf_collaboration_channel set inbound_sequence=#{sequenceNo},revision_no=revision_no+1,update_time=current_timestamp(3) where channel_id=#{channelId} and revision_no=#{expectedRevision} and inbound_sequence=#{sequenceNo}-1
